title: Customer Delivery Advisor
teaser: Become part of our team as a Customer Delivery Advisor, where you will act as a technology strategist to support clients in achieving business value through custom-built advisory services. Lead the development of technology strategies and operating models, working closely with senior customers. Ideal for experienced management consultants with deep expertise in technology-driven service delivery.
description:
Location: Saudi

Travel: 20%

Meet the Team

Here at Cisco Advisory, we strive to offer our clients a premium experience: combining the trusted Cisco brand with highly skilled and experienced individuals offering years of industry exposure and market understanding to provide a custom-built advisory service tailored to our clients’ specific needs.

We are currently looking for a senior management consultant who will act as a technology strategist to support our customers in achieving greater business value from technology by delivering services ranging from digitization strategy development to operating model design.

Our team assists clients in aligning the business and technology agendas as well as identifying areas where innovation can drive business value. This work includes optimising the technology budget and increasing the efficiency and effectiveness of the technology organisation through repositioning or redesigning the technology functions, and by assessing and optimising operational processes.

Your Impact

Work as a trusted advisor alongside senior customers to identify the relevant market trends and discover opportunities for technology to create new business value,

Develop or validate technology strategies, the supporting business cases, and define the required transformation programmes,

Build or enhance operating models catering for effective technology governance and alignment between business and technology,

Lead work to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the technology organisation, covering processes, tools & people, including the introduction of orchestration & automation,

Develop technology reference architectures, service portfolios, and contribute to the associated product development,

Compose & perform technology benchmarking and develop cost optimisation strategies & action plans, including service & application rationalisation,

Develop and evangelise innovative point of views on how digital technologies will transform the way business is conducted,

Act as an entrepreneur, including challenging traditional viewpoints at the client C-level,

Actively work to identify and develop new business opportunities for Cisco through advisory.

Minimum Qualifications

A master’s degree with a distinguished academic record, or a bachelor’s degree complemented by 10+ years relevant professional experience.

A minimum of 5+ years of experience within management consultancy plus a minimum of 5+ years in a senior role at a technology-driven service delivery organization.

Demonstrated experience navigating diverse segments, including Enterprise, Government, and Service Provider sectors.

Subject matter expertise in high-impact technologies, such as Smart Buildings, Smart Cities, or Digital Government initiatives.

Advanced proficiency in agile delivery methodologies and IT Service Management (ITSM), IOT, AI, as well as other technology trends.

Fluent Arabic is required

Preferred Qualifications

An MBA degree.

Multilingual proficiency

Superior written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences.

The capacity to manage multiple priorities effectively, combined with the flexibility to travel and work across the EMEAR region.

An entrepreneurial mindset characterized by the courage to challenge traditional viewpoints and provide strategic counsel at the C-suite level.

Nature of the Work: Hybrid Full Time

Hours of work: 48 hours per week

Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.

Application start and end date: Starting 18th August 2026 for approx. 4-6 weeks.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
